title: Yudkowsky's argument history: candidate pack 1
status: Candidate research pack, machine-prepared. Not editorially reviewed and not part of application data.
preparer: Claude (Anthropic), Claude Code session; passage finding by four fresh-context sub-agents against a shared offline cache

relations.said-it: Yudkowsky stated the same proposition as the take
relations.answered-it: he directly addresses this argument or premise and argues against it
relations.disagrees: he states the contrary conclusion without engaging this particular argument
relations.earlier-self: an earlier Yudkowsky text itself holds the take, premise included, and a located later Yudkowsky text explicitly rejects that proposition (the qualification says whether it refers back); later retrospectives reporting the earlier view are related, not earlier-self

roles.earliest-located: earliest passage found within the stated search scope; not a claim of first use
roles.strongest: clearest short statement for the relation
roles.later-restatement: a later restatement of the same point

voices.author: Yudkowsky's own assertion in a single-author text
voices.dialogue-turn: a turn attributed to Yudkowsky in a multi-party dialogue
voices.co-authored: text of a multi-author work; individual authorship of the sentence is not established
voices.retrospective: Yudkowsky describing his own earlier views
voices.fiction: a character or narrator in fiction or a parable; not a direct assertion

searchScope: See scope.md: all 1,076 LessWrong posts under the author's account (GraphQL, 2026-10-06), five MIRI PDFs, the TIME article, the AI-box page, one Staring into the Singularity capture, four mailing-list messages and three Arbital pages; from 2026-10-07 every SL4 (1,876, 2000–2009) and Extropians (3,012, 1996–2003) message under his name. Comments, Twitter/X, interviews and the 2025 book were not searched.
limits: Passages relate a take to documented text; they do not establish that an argument is correct.
"Earliest located" is bounded by the search scope and is not a claim of first use.
MIRI PDFs are later reprints; their wording is not authenticated for the original year unless stated.
Takes are generic phrasings written for this pack and are attributed to no one.
No human has reviewed these records.
